name: Aftershot
source:
Cleo Blackheart inherits a mansion from her father, what awaited her is something she could've never expected.
Follow along with Cleo as she meets new friends and learns more about the mansion.

[From [url=https://surohhorus.itch.io/aftershot-demo]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
克莱奥·布莱克哈特从父亲那里继承了一座豪宅，等待着她的却是她始料未及的。
跟随克莱奥结识新朋友并了解有关这座豪宅的更多信息。

[来自[url=https://surohhorus.itch.io/aftershot-demo]Itch.io[/url]]
